verdict.rationale: The official pricing page is public and confirms pay-as-you-go pricing with no contracts or sales calls required, and a free tier is documented, but the evidence pack contains no actual per-volume tier rates, overage pricing, or a specific dollar cost for dedicated IPs or email validation — only a vague mention that dedicated IPs cost 'an additional cost.' Missing for 10: concrete per-volume/overage rate tables, explicit dedicated-IP price, and any validation/add-on cost figures.
